verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a self-serve account export through its Marketing API ('Generate a new account export or download a finished account export'), and a community user confirms exporting their subscriber list themselves. However, the evidence never says what the export contains or what format it uses. missing for 10: documented inclusion of custom fields, tags, engagement history and the suppression list, a stated open file format (e.g. CSV), and independent confirmation of a full-audience export.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve

citations.quote: Generate a new account export or download a finished account export.
I just exported my Mailchimp subscriber list for safekeeping
